topology.name: TP4xPP4
topology.transport: direct source-to-destination over the single 100Gbps switch

prerequisites: TP4PP4-PACK-INVENTORY-001 has one complete model row with exact checkpoint/index hashes, final-shard completeness, packer revision and argv, expected layer split, per-rank bytes, scratch peak, and destination paths
BG-MOUNT-001, BG-PACK-001, BG-BUDGET-001, and BG-RECEIPT-001 exact patches are independently approved
every participating host has a fresh valid physical-mount receipt and operation_safe=true disk budget
the Spark storage queue owns generation-fenced storage_io leases for the named source, scratch, and destination hosts
execution: If all sixteen rank packs are already hash- and loader-qualified, skip generation and publish only missing destination files.
Otherwise run exactly the packer argv recorded by the inventory receipt; missing or ambiguous source, revision, command, codec, split, or byte estimate blocks only this model.
Write scratch only beneath the queue-approved generated scratch root. Never write beside or alter a source checkpoint.
Build and validate one BG-PACK-001 manifest per world rank before transfer.
Transfer each rank directly to its owning host using a generated temporary filename; do not forward through another Spark.
Verify destination byte count, SHA-256, rank manifest, and family loader before atomic publication.

After all sixteen publications verify, delete only scratch paths created by this generation and named in its receipt. Never delete, move, or overwrite a source checkpoint or pre-existing unknown path.
required_result: job, generation, lease, model, checkpoint/index/recipe/packer identities and exact executed argv
source and scratch host physical mount receipts plus preflight and peak byte budgets
for all sixteen ranks: host, world rank, PP stage, TP rank, final path, bytes, SHA-256, rank-manifest SHA-256, loader result, and publication generation
every generated scratch path and its cleanup result, or exact retained reason
before/after free bytes on every touched host and the next decision
acceptance: Sixteen final packs map rank 0..15 to spark0..sparkf with PP stage floor(rank/4) and TP rank rank modulo 4.
Every final pack is manifest-, SHA-256-, and loader-verified before publication.
All transfers are direct any-to-any over the single switch; no waterfall path is used.
Only job-generated scratch may be removed, and only after all required destinations verify.
Source checkpoints and pre-existing unknown paths are unchanged.
